Source: Faith and Fire, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

This madness comes and goes, linked to the cycle of the moon. When the moon is full, the character is manic and delirious; at the new moon he may be reserved and melancholic. At intervening times he may appear normal and unaffected.

Trigger/Effect: While in the grip of this derangement, the character's ability to resist frenzy and Rötschreck varies accordingly, increasing or decreasing by a Trait to reflect his mood depending on his link to the lunar cycle.

A distinct Storyteller-only Dark Ages variant of this derangement also exists: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.b09a83767c1c4336]{Lunacy (Dark Ages variant)}.
